_about: C §6 row 8: per-surface REGRESSION BOUNDS for .build/soak.py, judged on the quiet phase (seconds, whole response). Set 3 Oct 2026 from the tenth soak (dev database, Pi, SD card; after #48): p50 = 1.5 x measured, p95 = 2 x measured, each rounded up to a step of 0.25/0.3/0.5/0.75/1/1.25/1.5/2/2.5/3/3.5/4/4.5/5/6/7/8/9/10/12/15/20/25/30, and p95 capped at the soak's 30 s timeout. They replace the seventh soak's bounds (2 Oct), which were measured before the soak asked for full periods and with a 115 MB WAL; the tenth is the first full-period run with a settled WAL. They bound regression, not acceptability. All 17 are set.
